lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 5 — Ananias and Sapphira / The Apostles Persecuted

questions.questionText: I sold a piece of property with my wife Sapphira but kept part of the money. Who am I?
I am Ananias’s wife. Who am I?
What did Ananias do with part of the money?
options: He kept it back and laid the rest at the apostles’ feet

questions.questionText: Who said, “Ananias, how is it that Satan has so filled your heart that you have lied to the Holy Spirit?”
Peter said Ananias lied to whom?
What happened when Ananias heard these words?
What did young men do with Ananias?
options: They wrapped up his body, carried him out and buried him
They hid him in the temple

questions.questionText: About how many hours later did Sapphira come in?
Who asked Sapphira if this was the price they got for the land?
What did Sapphira answer?
What happened to Sapphira at Peter’s feet?
How did the whole church feel after this?
options: Great fear seized the whole church

questions.questionText: Where did the apostles perform many signs and wonders among the people?
What happened as people brought the sick into the streets?
options: They hoped Peter’s shadow might fall on them

questions.questionText: Crowds gathered from where, bringing their sick?
Who were filled with jealousy and arrested the apostles?
options: The high priest and all his associates, who were members of the party of the Sadducees

questions.questionText: Where did they put the apostles?
Who opened the jail doors at night and brought them out?
Who said, “Go… and tell the people all about this new life”?
Where did the apostles go at daybreak after the angel freed them?
What did the officers find when they opened the jail?
options: The jail securely locked but no one inside

questions.questionText: Someone told the leaders the men were teaching where?
Why did the captain not use force when bringing them?
options: They were afraid of being stoned by the people

questions.questionText: Who said, “We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name”?
Who said, “We must obey God rather than human beings”?
Who did they say God exalted to his own right hand as Prince and Savior?
I am a Pharisee, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people. Who am I?
Gamaliel reminded them of me, a man who was killed and whose followers scattered. I lived some time ago. Who am I named first?
I appeared in the days of the census and led a band of Galileans. Who am I?
Who said, “Leave these men alone! … If it is from God, you will not be able to stop these men”?
What did the Sanhedrin do to the apostles before letting them go?
How did the apostles leave the Sanhedrin?
options: Rejoicing because they had been counted worthy of suffering disgrace for the Name

questions.questionText: Day after day, where did they keep teaching and proclaiming the good news?
options: In the temple courts and from house to house
Only at night in secret boats

questions.questionText: True or false: Sapphira knew Ananias had kept part of the money.
options: True — it was with her full knowledge
True — she sold the land alone

questions.questionText: Peter told Sapphira the feet of the men who buried her husband were at the door. Who would carry her out?
What did people bring besides the sick?
options: Those tormented by impure spirits, and all of them were healed

questions.questionText: Who were the officers told to bring from jail for the full assembly of the elders of Israel?
True or false: The apostles stopped speaking about Jesus after they were flogged.
I opened the jail at night without the guards knowing. Who am I?
How many hours passed between Ananias’s death and Sapphira coming in?
